item.title: One hospitalized after Salt Lake City apartment fire
item.description: One person was hospitalized after an apartment complex fire in Salt Lake City Sunday morning.

item.title: Utah Resident Erin Jackson Fails To Defend Medal In Speed Skating 500m
item.description: Erin Jackson failed to defend her gold medal from the 2022 Olympics, finishing fifth in the Speed Skating Women's 500m event on Sunday.

item.title: Utah Basketball Adds Promising Austrian Big Fynn Schott
item.description: The Runnin’ Utes have pulled off a serious international recruiting win. Austrian big man Fynn Schott has committed to Utah’s 2026 recruiting class.

item.title: Powered by women, ‘Wuthering Heights’ digs up $34.8 million at the box office for a No. 1 debut
item.description: Emerald Fennell’s bold reimagining of “Wuthering Heights” brought crowds of women to movie theaters this weekend. The Warner Bros. release topped the box office charts and nabbed the title for the year’s biggest opening with $34.8 million in ticket sales in its first three days in North American theaters, according to studio estimates Sunday.

item.title: Utah Can’t Hold Late Lead, Drops Tight One to Cincinnati
item.description: Utah had a chance to steal one on the road and Jensen's squad couldn't finish the job against Cincinnati.

item.title: BYU Star Richie Saunders Out For Season With Injury
item.description: BYU basketball is without one of its top players.

item.title: In Italy, Jamaica’s bobsled team builds toward a 2034 medal run
item.description: They know they’re the underdogs. They know the road ahead is long. But with three sleds, women’s monobob, two‑man and four‑man, Jamaica’s bobsled athletes say they’re determined to push toward the podium at the 2034 Winter Games in Utah.

item.title: The Hat Trick: Matthews Leads USA Over Germany As Keller Makes Olympic Debut
item.description: The United States men's hockey team wrapped up group play on Sunday with a commanding 5-0 victory over Team Germany as they clinched Group C with nine points.

item.title: Small plane makes emergency landing on Legacy Parkway
item.description: A small plane experienced an engine malfunction on Sunday and was forced to make an emergency landing on the road.

item.title: GOP chair says enough signatures gathered to put Prop 4 repeal on ballot
item.description: Leaders of Utahns for Representative Government, the group at the helm of the effort to overturn Proposition 4, say they have gathered enough signatures to put the repeal before voters this November, though state election officials have not yet confirmed the numbers.
